readme_roadmap.title: Complete cinematic playback
readme_roadmap.detail: 545 sources / 16 worlds; zero complete scenes verified. The common film integrates a bounded persistent attached-FX queue: 23 sources / 25 requests. Preview tools now offers source-declared completion cinematics through the main menu/loader: four opening and 19 completion sources are reachable; filtered choices preserve original mission identities. Exact implementation-build UI controls cover two completion chains (19 and 33 directors), natural endings, same-mission re-entry and Escape after persistent birth, with tracked cleanup and unchanged preview profile files after initial unlock. Published preview 2026.11.06.2 also passes actual menu double-click after persistent birth and draw, return cleanup, three live-object service cancellations and both development lifecycle endpoints. Replay is inspection-only: no victory, native live replay state or Delphi gameplay admission. Native support controls match 100 samples / 1,700 words; two object-channel programs match eight preparations / 496 words. These bounded CPU matches do not verify full VM/world cadence. Inventory retains 59 gap sources, 56 general FX queue prerequisites and 282 strict-profile reviews. Native physical-stock controls cover 3,000 simultaneous objects, three reused slots and 3,003 retirements with supplied resources/support. Construction of the cohort's 158 Flick actors consumes no ordinary-world stock slots. Real mission occupancy, shared admission, error handling, full VM/world scheduling, gameplay triggers and complete visual/audio/subtitle parity remain open; no shared Rust quota is implemented.

readme_roadmap.title: Delphi movement and water
readme_roadmap.detail: Owned cold construction, physical initialization and jump services are CPU-validated. Dry sword physical/history -> secondary selection -> zero-time ANM now matches six 256-step native/Rust cases / 12,243,456 normalized words over 22 actors, reference buffers, payload and ordered lists, plus shared RNG endpoints. Manual heading/look is also composed in source order; five 256-step controls match 10,202,880 words, including pause, held jump and ordered local-time areas. Body pitch/roll alignment follows jump; four tilted-start controls match another 8,162,304 words, including cold pause and retained cache during settling. Installation clip definitions now load read-only from two acquired PE data layouts and are checked against the owned class; no original table or executable is bundled. Full primary/camera/target producers, auxiliary callbacks, nonordinary effects, water/turbo, combat and live admission remain unimplemented. Separate native-only full selected-owner acquisition covers 768 steps; it does not enlarge the Rust comparison. CPU composition is not gameplay readiness or verified fidelity.

readme_roadmap.title: Kabuto movement and growth
readme_roadmap.detail: Movement, jumping, collision at each size and growth triggers remain unimplemented. CPU controls cover cold group fields, animation-cache lifecycle, generated texture/shared RNG, ordered geometry/material retirement (32 scenarios, 144 removals) and registered custom cleanup (8 contexts, 36,624 words, 88 marks). The normal geometry-entry CPU packet also matches 64 native controls / 24,876 words; a separate camera/body header tail matches 384 controls / 4,992 words. The scalar/mode kernel matches 768 controls / 7,816 words / 209 notifications. A separate auxiliary constructor matches 16 contexts / 3,872 words, and its owned binding/mark/reference-clear slice matches 24 contexts / 11,596 words. A standalone template-clock query matches 512 native cases and reads owned Session resources/current channels. The owned geometry transition matches 84 native contexts / 23,322 words over selections, sound-service request order, channels, epochs, eleven reference matrices, auxiliary links and fifteen lists, with blending and 1,600-tick boundary controls. Upstream samples and an absent sound bank are supplied boundaries; fired-event effect cadence, device audio, active-extra teardown, transport and the real backend remain open. Second-auxiliary pose selection matches 1,024 native controls / 197,632 header words, with 64 additional Session/resource controls / 6,720 channel, clock and list words. Preceding poses/root identity and subsequent ANM/world cadence remain separate. Marked actors stay owned. Common actor transition/retirement, world dispatch, camera acknowledgement, GPU material/geometry rendering, full primary and live admission remain pending. CPU parity is not playable readiness or fidelity.
